confirm.title: Update C300X device agent
confirm.description:
Home Assistant will upload the packaged native agent through the currently configured maintenance API. SSH credentials are not needed. Active GUI and firewall patches are checked read-only first and refreshed only if they were already active.

Installed: {installed_version} (API {installed_api_version})
Packaged: {available_version} (API {available_api_version})
Reason: {reason}

ssh_install.title: Reinstall C300X device agent over SSH
ssh_install.description:
This installed agent cannot update itself yet. Home Assistant will use these one-time SSH credentials to install the packaged agent, then refresh only active GUI and firewall patches. The SSH credentials are not stored.

Installed: {installed_version} (API {installed_api_version})
Packaged: {available_version} (API {available_api_version})
Reason: {reason}

missing_alarm_entity.title: Configured C300X alarm entity is missing
missing_alarm_entity.description: {entry_title} references {entity_id}, but Home Assistant does not know that entity. Pick an existing alarm control panel entity in the integration options or clear the alarm setting.

unsupported_callback_url.title: C300X callback URL is not usable by the device agent
unsupported_callback_url.description: {entry_title} generated an unsupported callback target for {source}. The native device agent needs a local HTTP callback URL. Current callback scheme: {scheme}; host type: {host_type}. Configure Home Assistant with a local HTTP URL reachable from the C300X and avoid HTTPS, .local, loopback and link-local callback addresses.
